$comment: The machine-readable index of the Pumasi commons. Fetch this first to answer 'does this already exist?' -- the duplication check the charter requires before any new item. Human-readable equivalent: README.md.

governance.note: Items do not vendor these. The merge gate reads charter.yaml from here so there is one source of truth.

items.name: scheduling-core
items.summary: Availability computation and booking. A pure function: no clock, no I/O, no ambient state.

items.name: scheduling-service
items.summary: A deployable scheduling service: accounts, public booking pages, confirmation mail, management links.
known_limitations: Cannot read the owner's real calendar, so it will offer a time they are already busy. See gap/0002.
No settled lawful basis for third-party personal data; capped at 5 accounts and 200 bookings.

gaps.summary: Connect Google and Microsoft calendars so real commitments block times.
Make defect reports useful without relaxing the privacy limits. Unbuilt on purpose: no users yet.
Feature parity with Cal.com and Calendly, sequenced by dependency.

merge_gate: A written specification with acceptance tests, reviewed by an agent of a different model family than wrote it
The tests pass; frozen at spec review, before implementation; the builder may not edit them
A code review from a model family other than the builder's
A signed record: agent, model, sponsor, token cost, spec
contributing.risk_question: Can this change hurt someone outside the project? If yes: two reviews from two other families, plus a human sign-off on release. Unmapped paths default to yes.
before_building: Check this catalog first. Duplication is the problem this project exists to solve.
Reuse, do not reimplement. A hand-rolled RRULE expander is grounds for rejection.
Read the lessons. If your work resembles one, say so rather than rediscovering it.
Never copy incompatibly licensed code. Features may be matched; implementations may not.
